subject: ela
intro: Analyze how complex ideas and events interact.

items.prompt:
One factor affecting another is an:
A) interaction
B) index
C) title

A chain of causes and effects is a:
A) sequence
B) rhyme
C) font

An idea can:
A) inspire people to act
B) do nothing
C) only be printed

Read.

A discovery inspired an inventor, whose machine transformed an industry, reshaping a city's economy.

This BEST shows:
A) a chain in which each factor influences the next
B) unconnected events
C) that machines write themselves
items.answer: A) a chain in which each factor influences the next

steps: Chain of influence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a chain in which each factor influences the next

items.prompt:
Read.

An equal-rights idea inspired leaders, whose movements pressured the government to change laws.

The interaction runs:
A) idea -> leaders -> movements -> legal change
B) laws changed on their own
C) nothing is connected
items.answer: A) idea -> leaders -> movements -> legal change

steps: Chain of influence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) idea -> leaders -> movements -> legal change

items.prompt:
Why trace how factors INTERACT over a text?
A) it reveals how the whole complex situation developed
B) to count words
C) to ignore the topic
items.answer: A) it reveals how the whole complex situation developed

steps: Chains of influence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) it reveals how the whole complex situation developed

items.prompt:
Read.

A drought caused crop failures, which drove farmers to cities, which swelled an urban labor force that fueled factory growth.

The BEST description is:
A) a sequence in which each event sets up the next
B) unrelated facts
C) the factories caused the drought
items.answer: A) a sequence in which each event sets up the next

solution.answer: A) a sequence in which each event sets up the next

items.prompt:
To analyze a COMPLEX set of ideas and events, a reader should:
A) trace how specific individuals, ideas, and events influence one another over the text
B) read only the first line
C) ignore the connections
items.answer: A) trace how specific individuals, ideas, and events influence one another over the text

steps: Follow the interactions. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) trace how specific individuals, ideas, and events influence one another over the text
